headline: Meta brings its Muse AI agent inside Instagram
dek: According to TechCrunch and Engadget, the assistant arrives in DMs and organizes saved posts.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: What changed
body: Meta integrated Muse into Instagram direct messages, according to TechCrunch AI and Engadget.
Before, users had to switch to the Muse app to talk to the assistant (Engadget).

s3.label: How it works
s3.title: How it works
s3.body: Chats started in Instagram also appear in the Muse app.

points.t: Chat with Muse inside Instagram (TechCrunch AI).
Organizes posts and Reels people already saved (Engadget).
Acts through linked accounts, asking approval first (Meta Newsroom).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: A sales engine
body: CNBC Technology cites Forter Intelligence data on orders placed by AI agents.
Zuckerberg said many users already shop through the assistant (CNBC Technology).

stat.cap: of AI-agent orders, says Forter (CNBC Technology)

items.t: The feature reaches a few countries for now (TechCrunch AI).
The generic chatbot stays separate from Muse (Engadget).
Zuckerberg wants Muse to reach billions (Engadget).

caption.hook: Meta brings its Muse AI agent inside Instagram.
body: According to TechCrunch and Engadget, Meta integrated Muse into Instagram direct messages, and the assistant also suggests organizing saved posts and Reels. The feature reaches iOS and Android users in a few countries, and the automatic suggestion starts only in the US and Canada (TechCrunch AI).

CNBC cites Forter Intelligence data saying Muse accounted for 51% of purchase orders placed by AI agents in one week (CNBC Technology). Engadget notes Meta is repeating its strategy of pushing a new product into apps that already have billions of users.
caption.cta: Would you let an AI agent organize your saved posts and shop for you?
